scope: Four controlled runs using actual AkaneMemoryEngine.process_turn with twelve independent probes; exploratory pilot, not publication evidence.

fixed_controls.persona: original bundled desktop-pet persona and output template
fixed_controls.final_output: actual host validation, JSON repair and recovery; no two-field research override
fixed_controls.native_schema: actual Akane capability registry and capcore OpenAI schema conversion, preserving optional arguments
fixed_controls.fixture_tool: lookup_fixture with current step allowlist only
fixed_controls.timestamp_policy: Use live input timestamps so the host's actual wall-clock assistant writes stay chronological; preserve source input timestamps on replay. Original scenario timestamps remain provenance only.
fixed_controls.gap_policy: Same intervening conversation turns; no simulated one-day elapsed-time claim
fixed_controls.compaction_policy: Keep actual background due-check scheduling; configure a high raw token trigger and audit actual compaction and summary requests
fixed_controls.branch_policy: Independent physical stores and indexes, same synthetic logical namespace; restore setup via original SDK response replay without paid calls; verify evidence after explicit generated-ID and wall-clock-time mapping
fixed_controls.probe_leakage: Each probe starts from its own replay of the same post-gap setup; earlier probe responses never reach a later probe
fixed_controls.request_capture: Capture SDK HTTP JSON after true host request construction, without credentials or headers
fixed_controls.fee_claim: Usage-based tariff estimates and conservative budget accounting; no verified invoice cost
fixed_controls.cache_claim: Actual execution order and cache usage recorded; no causal cost-saving claim from four sequential runs

generation_settings.temperature: preserve actual host request, including normal 0.8 and original recovery settings
generation_settings.host_format_recovery: original engine behavior; every actual HTTP request separately counted

external_limits.budget_scope: Existing first-stage total including prior preflight, restricted pilot, retest, all failures and recovery requests
external_limits.stop_classification: Budget/context/transport interruptions are separate from host/model task failures; no artificial six-call cap
